first.rationale: I intend to test signup and onboarding simplification because both activation and onboarding completion are currently declining, while prior evidence suggests these changes can improve early adoption. I will avoid broad promotional pricing because its acquisition and revenue gains came with materially worse 30-day retention. A small guarded test should measure qualified activation and downstream revenue, not just completion.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, with the signup simplification component limited to SMB accounts. Shortened onboarding has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. Signup simplification also improves SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its small retention decline and lack of replication outside SMB require segment targeting and downstream guardrails. Evaluate activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention rather than completion alone.
